svg.title: A stated convergence criterion fires at iteration 4; the curve keeps rising to about iteration 25
svg.desc: Running-best reward against search iteration for five seeds, with their mean. A stated convergence criterion declares all five seeds converged at iteration 4, yet the mean keeps improving until about iteration 25.

g.text: at iteration 4 — and a 10× stricter threshold agrees
the mean has made 95 % of its gain only

text.tspan: The trailing-window variance test is satisfied by a low-variance run of early, seed-determined trials — a property of the
criterion, not of the optimiser. Later experiments therefore use fixed, pre-declared budgets instead.

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp2_convergence/results/processed/exp2_trajectories.csv · five seeds, 40 real iterations each
